name: Ashirwad
eligibility_rules: Girl should be 18 years old or above. Annual income of the family from all sources does not exceed Rs. 32,790/-.Parents/Guardians of the girl should be domiciled in Punjab State. The application can be given before the fixed date of marriage or after the 30 days of the marriage by the applicant for getting financial assistance. The amount of shagun/Ashirwad is limited up to two girls of the concerned family under the scheme. Financial assistance is given to Scheduled Castes/Christian girls, Backward Classes/Castes, Economically weaker sections girls, daughters of widows of any caste at the time of their marriage, and Scheduled Castes widows/divorcees at the time of their re-marriage.
documents_required: Aadhar card of the applicant. Proof of date of birth (D.O.B).Income certificate. Cast
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Applicants have to visit the official portal. Click on Applicant Registration. On the new page, the registration form will appear. Applicants have to provide the required details. Submit.
